entityDescription: Micrima Limited is a company that originated out of Bristol University in 2007.It has developed a Radio-wave based technology for breast cancer detection.We expect to commercialise MARIA®in late 2022/early 2023.The tool will initially be deployed as a diagnostic adjunct to Mammography but ultimately, we are looking to deploy the technology for use as a automated breast cancer screening tool in remote and community settings.The use of radio waves overcomes the two main issues of the current predominant screening modality (Mammography) that has issues in denser breast tissue (which significantly impacts the sensitivity and specificity of the device in 40%-50% of the existing screening population and prevents the additional screening of younger women).In addition, Mammography uses ionising radiation which limits the frequency of use of the device, which can allow cancers to develop and spread outside the breast, which significantly reduces the chances of survival.

entityName: UNIVERSITEIT ANTWERPEN - LEIA-Lab for Equilibrium Investigations and Aerospace
entityDescription:
LEIA aims to perform pioneering research in the domains of the vestibular system and of spaceflight.
LEIA began with performing research on the use of various tests to evaluate the function of the vestibular organ for the purpose of routine clinical testing. As a logical next step, different research projects were initiated to increase our understanding of certain vestibular-related diseases and conditions. Currently, LEIA’s research focus entails (i) developinga treatment option for Mal de Débarquement Syndrome (MdDS) as one of the few centres in the world, (ii) investigating the effect of a otolith-vestibular implant to treat patients with severe bilateral vestibular function loss, (iii) using state-of-the-art magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)techniques to diagnose Ménière’s Disease, (iv) to test the outcome of the Balance Belt in chronic dizzy patients, and more.
The second domain of research entails the investigation of the effects of spaceflight on the vestibular system and on the brain. Because the vestibular organ fails to detect gravity-dependent head movements in a weightless environment, downstream functions of the vestibular system, such as gaze stabilisation, balance, orientation and navigation, are affected in this condition. LEIA’s research activities in the field of spaceflight include (i) the investigation of the effects of pharmaceutical treatments for (space) motion sickness on the vestibular organ, (ii) testing the vestibular organ function before and after long-duration spaceflight by means of centrifugation, currently in already 71% of the cosmonauts who have flown to the ISS, and (iii) running the first prospective MRI study in cosmonauts and astronauts to uncover various structural and functional changes to the brain in response to space missions.
With these research endeavours, LEIA aims to resolve various forms of dizziness and imbalance in patients and to address biomedical challenges for astronauts engaging in human space exploration missions.

entityDescription: SATIM is an industry leader in the automatic, Al-based detection and classification of objects on Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) satellite imagery, being recognized among the main players on the market. Since 2012, SATIM has been creating innovative and high-quality products and services, among others, in collaboration with the European Space Agency. ESA has funded 9 research and development projects with some of them primarily focused on SAR signatures simulation and Al-based object detection and classification. Within two projects with ESA (SATREC 1.0 and SATREC 2.0), SATIM has developed two innovative software packages for highly-accurate SAR signature simulation (SSIG software), and for automatic Al-based object detection and classification on SAR (OREC software). In OREC software, simulated SAR signatures are used to train Al models. This synthetic data is generated in SATIM's SAR simulator (SSIG). SSIG allows generating simulated SAR signatures of any 3D object and any SAR system. Using synthetic SAR signatures to train Al models, SATIM has the capabilities to provide near real time, highly accurate detection and classification of different objects on SAR data acquired from different SAR sensors. Moreover, SATIM’s AI models are specifically optimized for detecting and classifying a various of objects across multiple domains. The company has developed specialized AI models that can automatically detect and classify vessels with 110 different classes, aircraft with 18 classes, and vehicles with 8 classes. These models enable SATIM to provide detailed and precise object recognition, making it an invaluable partner for industries such as maritime surveillance, aviation monitoring, and ground vehicle tracking, where rapid and reliable data interpretation is crucial.

entityDescription:
Rheinmetall Norway AS has been an established player in the Nordic region for over half a century, located in Tønsberg, south of Oslo. The company cooperates closely with Norwegian and Swedish Armed Forces, developing capabilities for existing and future needs.
Rheinmetall Norway specializes in high-tech products for dismounted soldiers as well as sensor and observation systems, reconnaissance and fire control systems. These range from target acquisition systems, cameras, 40mm fire control system, weapon improvement and weapons mount products to advanced mortar systems. A first-rate engineering department keeps Rheinmetall Norway on the global cutting edge of defence-technology making it the ideal strategic partner for both, military users and defence industry, when it comes to developing new capabilities for the world’s armed forces.

entityDescription:
Quantum Blockchains Inc. is a startup aiming to create functioning Blockchain technology capable of resisting the currently emerging threats from Quantum Computers. The company is planning a radical step, and instead of post-quantum algorithms, it will use the latest achievements of quantum cryptography to create provably secure solutions, which enhance data protection, integrity and processing speed.
The startup is registered as a private limited company in the city of Lublin in Poland in the European Union. It’s headquarters are in Lublin and its secondary office is in the city of Lodz, Poland.
It currently employees five specialists: quantum information scientists and developers. Five company shareholders’ are also active in its development.
As for the mid of 2022 the company works on the core development of its quantum blockchain concept and implementation, on the software for hardware QRNG, quantum cryptography Knowledge Graph and on scientific foundations for the future quantum blockchains where quantum processes can redefine both security properties and consensus algorithms to elevate blockchains to the new dimensions of quantum processing.

AdvEOTec is a Test House, with strong expertise in Optoelectronics and Measurement. Its activities are mainly oriented to demanding environments in sectors such as space, defence, and submarine telecommunications. AdvEOTec is also involved in collaborative research programs. Two divisions lead the business activities. SERVICE Division : The main activities are measurements of optoelectronics and Photonics based components and systems. Component test and qualification programs are taken in charge by AdvEOTec (vacuum, thermal, humidity, vibration, solar simulator, radiation, ESD, ...). When required AdvEOTec develops its own instrumentation and proposes new measurement procedures. INDUSTRY Division : The main activities deal with development of sensors and measurement systems where optoelectronics (light sources and detectors, optical fibres, ...) has an important role. AdvEOTec has a proven track of records in system developments when multidisciplinary approach is required : optoelectronics, electronics, RF, Optics, software, packaging, vacuum technologies. A large set of building blocks is available to provide new solutions in automated test solutions : software, optical fibre communication, RF sensors, micropulse detection, signal processing, ...). entityDescription:
Agreed’s mission is to accelerate the adoption of regenerative farming practices, thereby reducing global CO2e emissions while improving the profitability of farms. We are doing so by becoming the data and decision hub for the rapidly expanding regenerative agriculture supply chain within the $10 trillion agriculture industry. Agreed has a specific initial focus on reducing farmers’ dependence on synthetic nitrogen fertiliser given it is an overlooked operational risk, as well as a climate and environmental risk, for farmers and their financial lenders.
Agreed provides data for banks to measure and reduce the nitrogen-related portion of their debt books while connecting farmers to the resources and support they need for a successful transition to more regenerative farming practices, thus improving soil health and reducing nitrogen dependency.

entityDescription:
Intecs S.p.A. is an Italian private Company at the forefront in the design and implementation of high-tech electronic systems for the Aerospace, Defence, Transport markets, where safety, reliability, innovation and quality are the key ingredients for success. 
Intecs was founded in 1974. Its core business is the field of software controlling advanced defence systems. Since its foundation Intecs has been expanding its market areas and for ~50 years has been working also in the Space sector leading to the acquisition of a strong expertise in key technological areas, from satellite EO infrastructures and applications to GNSS and on-board/embedded systems

Intecs provides the most innovative software&hardware technology, engineering services and products for dependable safety and mission-critical electronics systems. 

Intecs designs and develops applications, tools, software, hardware components and products for Aerospace, Defense, Railway, Automotive, Finantial and Smart Systems markets in cooperation with major European and Italian Industries, Organizations, Universities and Research Centres.

Intecs is an international leader in System Engineering, mastering the whole value chain from Prototypes, Simulators, Automated Test Equipment to the finished product.

Our values are driven by passion for technological excellence and for continuous improvement, reliability and work dedication, respect for the individual and transparency-based relationships.

Precisely these values are leading Intecs to be one of the most advanced high-tech company in Europe.

Intecs Solutions shares with its customers the highly valuable knowledge it has available in its Centres of Excellence:
• Embedded Real Time Systems
• Model Driven Engineering
• Verification and Validation
• Guidance Navigation and Control
• Surveillance and Command & Control systems
• Human Machine Interface (HMI)
• Earth Observation and GIS
• GNSS System
• Hardware, ASIC & FPGA design
• Physical & PCB design

Intecs employs around 300 professionals. More than 80% of the staff have a university degree in engineering, computer science or other technical disciplines.

Our headquarter is in Rome, while other operational sites are located in Pisa, Naples, Milan, Turin, Reggio Emilia, Genoa and Bari.

entityName: CESI - CENTRO ELETTROTECNICO SPERIMENTALE ITALIANO GIACINTO MOTTA S.P.A.
entityDescription:
CESI is a world-leading technical consulting and engineering company in the field of technology and innovation for the electric power sector. Through its Division KEMA Labs, CESI is the world leader for the independent Testing, Inspection and Certification activities in the electricity industry. With a legacy of more than 60 years of experience, CESI operates in 70 countries worldwide and supports its global clients in meeting the energy transition challenges. The CESI’s key global clients include major utilities, Transmission System Operators, Distribution System Operators, power generation companies, system integrators, global electromechanical and electronic manufacturers. CESI also provides civil and environmental engineering services. In addition, CESI also develops and manufactures high efficiency space solar cells based on III-V compounds for civil applications.
CESI is a fully independent joint-stock company with facilities in:- Italy: Milan (Headquarter), Piacenza, Seriate, and subsidiaries in - Italy: Guidonia, RM (ISMES SpA), - Germany: Berlin (IPH GmbH) and Mannheim (FGH GmbH), - United Arab Emirates: Dubai (CESI Middle East FZE), - Brazil: Rio de Janeiro (CESI Brasil Consultoria Ltda), - United States: Chalfont (KEMA Powertest LLC, KEMA Realty LLC) Knoxville (EnerNex LLC) Washington DC (CESI USA Inc.), - The Netherlands: Arnhem (KEMA B.V., KEMA Generators B.V.), - Czech Republic: Prague (Zkušebnictví, a. s.), - China: Shangai (KEMA (Shangai) Technology Consulting Company Limited) and with commercial representatives in almost all countries worldwide.
CESI has more than 30 years experience in the research, development and production of high efficiency space solar cellsfor civil applications and is one of the topglobal suppliers of multi-junction cells using based III-V semiconductors. CESI has strongly invested for decades in developing its own proprietary technology going through all the roadmap steps from single junction to multi-junctions, while being involved in the main space research and development programs at EU and international level.
The research activities of CESI have been performed through time thanks to relevant internal investments and to the financial support of the Italian Space Agency (ASI) and of the European Space Agency (ESA). CESI has cooperated in many significant projects for interplanetary missions (on planets such as Mercury, Mars and Jupiter). The heritage of CESI includes more than 200,000 manufactured solar cells, powering more than 100 civil satellites for Clients from over 25 different countries worldwide.
Solar cells are manufactured at our facility in Milan and can be provided either bare or SCA (aka CIC) to serve the civil markets with the best cost versus quality mix. CESI is particularly proud of its distinctive positioning based on our attention and capability to shape and fine tune our solar cells for the specific needs and applications of our customers. Our standard triple junction space cells are state of the art with 30% typical efficiency and are qualified for both LEO and GEO missions according to ECSS-E-ST20-08C standards. Aimed to serve the new space economy CESI has also invested in new additional and innovative products characterized by lightweight and low cost features. In our continuous improvement effort, we are already investing with effective results into four-junction cells towards space efficiencies beyond 35%. 
The CESI Management System is certified according to ISO 9001, ISO 45001/OHSAS 18001, ISO 14001.
CESI is accredited for the testing, inspection & certification services according to ISO/IEC 17025, ISO/IEC 17020, ISO/IEC 17065.
The Code of Ethics, adopted in 2002, was updated on July 2022. The Anti Corruption Compliance Program is certified in accordance with ISO 37001:2016 Antibribery Management Systems.

entityDescription:
From our headquarters in Norway, we have been pioneering the ground segment business since 1968, and have introduced the near real-time concept within operational monitoring services as early as the 1990’s.
Our mission
Today our mission is to be the worlds leading commercial satellite centre. What does that mean for you? The bottom line: we give you access to satellites anytime, anywhere.
Being able to do so, we have heavily invested in, and built a network of global ground stations, consisting of more than 300 + remotely controlled antennas. With 28 sites worldwide, we provide optimized locations for satellites in polar, inclined and equatorial orbits. In addition, we offer Earth Observation services with the fastest available delivery times.
Our customers include both public and commercial users who have urgent, time-sensitive, operational requirements, as well as satellite owners and operators.
With 24/7/365 operations, KSAT is here for you whenever you need it!
Our organisation
At KSAT we have four core values that we work towards every day.
Our core values:
- Kvalitet - Quality
- Stolthet - Pride
- Ansvar - Responsibility
- Trivsel - Thriving
More than 400 of our fantastic employees reflect these values in our everyday work life. A majority is based at the head office in Tromsø, and the remaining are located at the Svalbard Ground Station and at our sales offices in Oslo, Stockholm and Colorado.
We want KSAT to be a challenging interesting and attractive workplace. Our goal is that we strive to increase our revenue and the "fun at work"-factor with the same percentage each year.
Regardless of the fact that we have been rapidly expanding through more than 50 years in business, we have managed to keep our entrepreneurial spirit burning brightly!

entityDescription:
Forsway visionary team sees the integration of satellite and terrestrial networks as the most efficient way to expand broadband services in regions with limited broadband infrastructure/capacity. We think the true direction of 5G technology should be to connect everyone, not to develop higher data rates for a few. We are headquartered in Sweden, but have a global production ecosystem and customer base: the majority of the end users of our solution are located in the developing world. 
Our solutions are designed as an extension of terrestrial broadband networks from the sky, using broadcasting satellites for the delivery of broadband to the subscribers, and terrestrial networks (mobile, dial-up or others) to carry the return channel. This hybrid solution combines the coverage of satellite communications with terrestrial broadband, resulting in a solution capable of breaking one of the main the cost barriers for global internet access: customer premise equipment hardware costs. We can adapt our solution to multiple deployment scenarios (including integration with customer operation and business support), and diverse up/downstream technologies; we also develop OEM solutions. 
Founded as a spin-off from Nokia Home Communications, our first modem was developed and demonstrated for Swedish Direct-To-Home market leader Viasat AB in 2005, pioneering internet over satellite as a complement to TV broadcasting. Since then, we have sold more than 50,000 terminals globally (in x 33 countries). As a leading developer of hybrid solutions in Europe; we have participated in multiple projects with the European Space Agency ESA under the ”Advanced Research In Telecommunications Systems” product development projects (ARTES 3-4) as well as national programs in Sweden. This funding has enabled both the development and the improvement of Forsway’s main solution.
.

Company description: The mission of the ISP is to contribute to increasing the quality of Italian scientific and technological research in the polar regions, and to provide knowledge on global changes in support of Italian and European environmental policies by the development of new technologies and survey methodologies.
The Institute aims to be a reference point for:
- CNR polar research; as ISP has extensive links to universities as well as national and international public and private bodies. ISP offers multidisciplinary skills and technologies that are essential to studying and protecting the environment;
- scientific personnel, able to make qualified contributions to the National Antarctic Research Programme (PNRA), the Arctic Research Programme (PRA) and European Commission projects through the development of research and monitoring activities;
- interdisciplinary polar cooperation and research, including the development of meetings, publications, research opportunities and complementary activities, and interacting with society;
- the standardisation of measurements and preparation methods to improve the quality of results, and the development of coordinated measures aimed at common research plans and/or general common objectives;
- the training of the next generation of polar scientists.

Fulfilling our mission will allow us to improve our understanding of the climatic changes taking place in the Arctic and Antarctic environments and possible future developments at both polar and global levels. Our studies address research issues related to both the chemical/geochemical and physical aspects of the poles using a multidisciplinary approach to protect these vulnerable extreme environments. The repercussions of climate change on these dynamics are still largely unknown and will require integrated research using long term multidisciplinary methods to understand them fully.

entityName: UNU- Institute for Environment and Human Security (UNU-EHS)
entityDescription:
The United Nations University (UNU) is the academic arm of the United Nations and acts as a global think tank. The mission of the Institute for Environment and Human Security (UNU-EHS) is to carry out cutting edge research on risks and adaptation related to environmental hazards and global change. The institute’s research promotes policies and programmes to reduce these risks, while taking into account the interplay between environmental and societal factors.
Research areas include climate change adaptation incorporating insurance-related approaches, environmentally induced migration and social vulnerability, ecosystem services and environmental deterioration processes, models and tools to analyze vulnerability and risks linked to natural hazards, with a focus on urban space and rural-urban interfaces. Research is always conducted with the underlying goal of connecting solutions to development pathways.
Beyond its research mandate, UNU-EHS is actively engaged in education. It offers the joint Master of Science degree programme “The Geography of Environmental Risks and Human Security” with the University of Bonn. UNU-EHS also hosts a number of international PhD projects and courses on global issues of environmental risks and sustainable development. The institute is based in Bonn, Germany.
